newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Investor says no comment on Orrefors talk.
newsitem.headline: Investor says no comment on Orrefors talk.

text.p: Swedish investment group Investor AB was on Friday making no comment about discussions it was having with the two other main owners of Orrefors Kosta Boda.
A joint statement from Investor, Proventus AB and Royal Copenhagen AS early Friday said they were in talks over the future ownership of the Swedish luxury glassmaker.
"The parties have agreed that they will not comment before everything is settled," Investor spokesman Nils Ingvar Lundin told Reuters.
"The comments will be made at the latest before the bourse opens on Tuesday."
Trading in Orrefors was suspended on the Stockholm bourse at the company's request. The stock was last traded at 140 crowns.
Royal Copenhagen earlier this month raised it stake in Orrefors to 17.1 percent.
This prompted Proventus to raise its holding to 21.1 percent with an option to take a further 9.1 percent,
Proventus also bid 145 crowns a share to Orrefors shareholders for share up to 20 percetn of capital.
Investor, as of July 27 this year, owned 23.1 percent of Orrefors Kosta Boda.
